comment: Prof. Van Gelder is a wonderful dance teacher, she's caring & wants you to succeed. She gives great critiques that will help you improve if you practice. Occasionally she'll get off on a tangent during class, which takes up class time, but usually she ties her stories back into the dance history that we're learning about while in class. Fun class!
Just take the class with her. You will never regret it!!!!!! One of the most friendly professors in UR and her course is easy as long as you show your passion.

Anne is truly the gem of the dance/ theater department. Her lectures are clear and well organized, and she is very specific on what details are necessary for the test. She cares about seeing her students succeed and is very gracious in terms of altering due dates for her students benefit. There are a decent amount of paper assignments though.

She truly cares for each and every student. She looks for individual growth and will provide both positive and negative feedback, which is amazing and something that not all dance professors will do. Grading criteria could have been more clear.
She is amazing--take this course! You will learn a lot!!

Anne is quite the character. She definitely cares about you and your well being in and out of her class. Don't miss class, and keep up on your reflections, critiques, research paper and performances and you will be fine. Tickets to mandatory shows can be expensive - that's my only complaint. Love the opportunity to use my pointe shoes.
Anne is absolutely wonderful! She's so much fun in class and is SO knowledgeable on dance history. Highly recommend.
incredible ability to expand my knowledge and understanding of the complex history of dance. inspiring and captivating!
she's a little flighty but the class isn't that hard
